name: calibrated_v1
summary: Optional dynamics beyond Shiu et al. 2024 that keep odour coding sparse and specific and stop latching, without changing the published sugar->MN9, bitter->MN9 and looming->Giant Fibre results.

slow_inhibition.scope: antennal-lobe local neurons (class ALLN) with inhibitory sign
slow_inhibition.rationale: GABA-B-like slow inhibition in the antennal lobe (e.g. Wilson & Laurent 2005; Olsen & Wilson 2008); restores glomerulus-specific projection-neuron responses

calibration: cognition/calibrate_dynamics.py grids default, al_slow, refine, adapt_fine (Mac, 2026-09-24)
results_held_out: 8 other ORN types + vinegar/CO2/cVA, seeds 1-2: KC 3.5-4.0% (0-8.3%), overlap 0.16-0.24, PN off-target 0.24-0.33, latching 0
not_calibrated_for: Janelia MaleCNS (apply at your own risk; calibrate separately)
superseded_by: dynamics_calibrated.json (2026-09-25): v1 kept PNs only 9% glomerulus-specific
